source.title: feat(design-data): anatomy review of the collections family (A3)

after.name: container
after.description: The step list: a row (or column, when vertical) of steps. It is the root.

after.name: label
after.description: Text label of a step; optional.

after.name: visual
after.description: Circle that shows the step number, or a checkmark once the step is completed.

fields.before: A single step in the list.
fields.after: A single step in the list; repeated once per entry of items.
Connecting line from this step to the next. Absent on the last step. It takes its step's completed or incomplete state.

after.name: default
after.description: The steps. Each entry of the items option is drawn as one copy of the step part.

fields.after: Figma S2 Web steplist page (.Step, Track 1-2, Track 2-3). There is no React Spectrum or SWC steplist. container added as the root. Decision A67 D4a: track is a child of step, absent on the last step, taking its step's completed or incomplete state; this goes against Figma's layer structure (n-1 Track instances on the container), so Design confirms through the steplist needs-decision bead. track-size deleted (a property name used as a part); step kept (the registry's step-item is removed).
